title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-20
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a hot ’71 show with a killer Other One, electric Ripple and the smashing Not Fade Away → Love Light sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard source and faithful presentation of The Other One as one continuous track. Fans highlight the high energy of the set – especially the Not Fade Away → Love Light run, a scorching Other One and an electric Ripple – making this a quintessential 1971 Dead performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are strongly positive (4‑5 stars) and emphasize both outstanding musical moments and excellent sound quality, leading to a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear soundboard mix; reviewers note the benefit of not splitting The Other One into multiple tracks. Minor comment about live system exposing tiny tuning quirks, but overall a clean and listenable recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, typical 1971 set with strong transitions; the first‑set ending and second‑set close are repeatedly called killer.
